name: Crude and product tank farms and floating roofs
aliases: Crude and product tank farms and floating roofs
principle: Vertical cylindrical tanks hold crude and products; floating roofs rise and fall with the liquid to cut the vapour space. External floating roofs suit medium-flash liquids such as crude, naphtha and diesel; internal floating roofs suit low-flash products such as petrol and jet fuel.

process_steps.name: Receive product by pipe or ship
Store in floating-roof tank
equipment: external or internal floating roof tank

advantages: Lower evaporative losses than fixed-roof tanks
limitations: The Wikipedia page gives no emission-reduction figures or seal details
